content.title: Exponential integrability of SLE Minkowski content
content.abstract: Let $0<κ<8$, $d=1+κ/8$, and $q=2/(2-d)$. Let $μ$ be the $d$-dimensional Minkowski content measure of either chordal $\mathrm{SLE}_κ$ in $\mathbb H$ from $0$ to $\infty$ or two-sided whole-plane $\mathrm{SLE}_κ$ through $0$. We prove that there exist constants $c_κ,C_κ\in(0,\infty)$ such that \[ \mathbb E\exp\left\{c_κ\left(\frac{μ(D)}{(\operatorname{diam} D)^d}\right)^q\right\}\le C_κ\] for every deterministic bounded Borel set $D$ of positive diameter in the corresponding domain.
